mapper.select: SELECT mt.mentoring_number AS mentoringNumber, m.member_number AS memberNumber, m.member_name AS memberName, s.grad_school AS gradSchool, s.grad_depart AS gradDepart, f.file_name AS fileName, DATE_FORMAT(mt.created_at, '%Y.%m.%d') AS createdAt, sub.subject_name AS subject FROM UB_MEMBER m INNER JOIN UB_MENTORING mt ON m.member_number = mt.mentor_number LEFT JOIN UB_SURVEY_MENTOR s ON m.survey_number = s.survey_number LEFT JOIN UB_FILE f ON m.file_number = f.file_number INNER JOIN UB_SUBJECT sub ON mt.subject_number = sub.subject_number WHERE m.member_type = 'MENTOR' AND m.member_state = '계정 활성화' ORDER BY mt.mentoring_number DESC

SELECT m.member_number AS memberNumber, m.member_name AS memberName, m.member_nickname AS memberNickname, s.grad_school AS gradSchool, s.grad_depart AS gradDepart, f.file_name AS fileName, DATE_FORMAT(mt.created_at, '%Y.%m.%d') AS createdAt, mt.MENTORING_TITLE AS mentoringTitle, mt.MENTORING_GOAL AS mentoringGoal FROM UB_MEMBER m LEFT JOIN UB_SURVEY_MENTOR s ON m.survey_number = s.survey_number LEFT JOIN UB_FILE f ON m.file_number = f.file_number LEFT JOIN UB_MENTORING mt ON m.member_number = mt.mentor_number WHERE m.member_number = #{memberNumber}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UB_MATCHING WHERE mentee_number = #{menteeNumber} AND matching_state IN ('매칭중', '요청 처리 중')
